experiment: N1 / C7+B3 AR rescoring of frozen text variants

protocol.paraphrase_author: Claude Opus 5 (non-Gemma family), blind to all AR scores
protocol.scoring: AR reconstruct(text) then cosine against x_i with the E1-E7 mean direction m_hat projected out of BOTH sides; raw cos also reported
primary_endpoints: para_tp vs orig  (C7: does third-party equivalent wording retain the score?)
entity_swap vs orig  (B3: does referent identity matter at all?)
word_shuffle vs orig  (is AR a bag-of-words topic detector?)
p3_only / p12  (is the score carried by the next-token prediction?)
quote_strip_p2  (is the score carried by the verbatim quotation?)

__generic_fixed__.note: fixed generic-text floor for the E1-E7 cohort, measured directly
